title: § 301-10.309 What will I be reimbursed if I am authorized to use common carrier transportation or a rental vehicle and I use a POV instead?

before.text:
§ 301-10.309 What will I be reimbursed if I am authorized to use common carrier transportation or a rental vehicle and I use a POV instead?

Link to an amendment published at 88 FR 2845, Jan. 18, 2023.

You will be reimbursed the applicable POV rate on a mileage basis, plus per diem, not to exceed the total constructive cost of the authorized method of common carrier transportation plus per diem. Your agency must determine the constructive cost of transportation and per diem by common carrier under the rules in § 301-10.310.

[FTR Amdt. 2015-03, 80 FR 27260, May 13, 2015]

after.text:
§ 301-10.309 What will I be reimbursed if I am authorized to use common carrier transportation or a rental vehicle and I use a POV instead?

You will be reimbursed the applicable POV rate on a mileage basis, plus per diem and related travel expenses, not to exceed the total constructive cost of the authorized method of transportation. Your agency must determine the constructive cost in accordance with § 301-70.105(a).

[88 FR 2845, Jan. 18, 2023]

changes.summary: The POV reimbursement sentence adds related travel expenses and changes the ceiling from constructive common-carrier transportation cost plus per diem to the total constructive cost of the authorized transportation method.

changes.summary: The agency constructive-cost instruction changes from transportation and per diem by common carrier under § 301-10.310 to constructive cost in accordance with § 301-70.105(a).
